svg.text: Transform detects nothing of its own. It consumes what Classify measured and picks a strategy from edge intersections.
then shrink for a cast shadow
target: final output ≥ 800 px longest side
OFF → Lanczos4, cap 1.33× · ON → Real-ESRGAN, cap 1.42×
first match wins — reads intersects-top/bottom/left/right and salient-bbox only
bbox present AND any edge intersects
no bbox at all — last resort
1 intersection — touched edge flush, WhiteSpaceMargin on the far edge
2 opposing — pinned axis at full extent, other axis centres on the bbox
2 adjacent — corner flush; each axis shrinks or extends away from the corner
3 intersections — one axis pinned, the open axis anchors flush
4 intersections — centred square crop at min(w, h), no extension
KO only when the image is under
crop first if the whole bbox stays in frame;
otherwise extend, and fill the new pixels
Tx_util_BgStretch — fill tier by extension ratio
≤ 125% → mirror or clamp the border pixels outward
seam feathering after tiers 1 and 2; never a Gaussian blur
Tx_CropSquare still compiles but no route reaches it. Phenotype and det slot were removed from routing in the 2026-08-11 rework — they stay on the record for other stages.
